title: RST Controller
text: Predictive control using a polynomial representation, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Controller parameterization} sets the parameterization method Controller, {R polynomial}, {S polynomial}, {T polynomial}, {Model discrete transfer function numerator} sets the transfer function numerator, {Model discrete transfer function denominator} sets the transfer function denominator, {Control horizon (samples)} sets the number of control-horizon samples, {Control weighting factor} sets the weighting factor, {System dead time (samples)} sets the number of dead-time samples and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sampling interval. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Controller parameterization
params.values: Parameterization method Controller polynomials (default) | Generate polynomials

params.name: R polynomial
params.values: R polynomial values 1 (default) | positive, scalar or vector

params.name: S polynomial
params.values: S polynomial values 1 (default) | positive, scalar or vector

params.name: T polynomial
params.values: T polynomial values 1 (default) | positive, scalar or vector

params.name: Model discrete transfer function numerator
params.values: Transfer function numerator 1 (default) | scalar or vector

params.name: Control horizon (samples)
params.values: Number of control-horizon samples 5 (default) | positive integer

params.name: System dead time (samples)
params.values: Number of dead-time samples 2 (default) | 0 or a positive integer

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Sampling interval -1 (default) | default value or a positive number
